'''Adam Trunzo''' finished 3rd at the [[2021 Fifth Annual GEMPC]].<ref name="pc-gempc5">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/jokerking-wins-batmouses-5th-gempc/ Jokerking wins Batmouse's 5th GEMPC], starwarsccg.org (26 March 2021). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024125440/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/jokerking-wins-batmouses-5th-gempc.html Internet Archive]</ref> Trunzo also played the [[2021 Match Play Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2021-match-play-championship/ 2021 Match Play Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>

== Card credits ==
Adam Trunzo is credited on [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards]] for the original concept of one card.<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card is in [[Virtual Set 14]], released 18 March 2021.
One card in all (Concept: 1).<ref name="cardlabels-0bc4377d9" /> The tables give each card, its side, its set and the set's release date, the card it was made from (the title in the strip along the card's bottom edge, when it differs), and the credit exactly as printed. The same credits are listed under [[Card Credits#Adam Trunzo|Adam Trunzo]] on the Card Credits page.<ref name="cardcredits">[[Card Credits]], SWCCG Wiki (generated from card_labels.json at commit 0bc4377d9).</ref>
